```{r Read the files}
#NS and COPD transcript 
NS <- read.csv("/Users/gagandeepkaur/Desktop/Figure 7/Figure 7B/Results/NS_transcript_density.csv")
COPD <- read.csv("/Users/gagandeepkaur/Desktop/Figure 7/Figure 7B/Results/Copd_transcript_density.csv")
sen <- read.csv("//Users/gagandeepkaur/Desktop/Figure 7/Figure 7D/Sen_gene.csv")
genes <- sen$Genes
```

```{r Heatmap}
# Filter
filtered_ns <- NS[NS$Gene %in% genes, ]
filtered_copd <- COPD[COPD$Gene%in% genes, ]

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# Create gene x sample matrix
gene_matrix_ns <-  filtered_ns%>%
  select(Gene, Sample, Density_normalized) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Sample,
    values_from = Density_normalized
  )
gene_matrix_c <-  filtered_copd%>%
  select(Gene, Sample, Density_normalized) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Sample,
    values_from = Density_normalized
  )

write.csv(gene_matrix_ns, "/Users/gagandeepkaur/Desktop/gene_density_matrix_ns.csv")
write.csv(gene_matrix_c, "/Users/gagandeepkaur/Desktop/gene_density_matrix_copd.csv")

```


```{r z scoring of the data}
# Convert to data frames/matrices
ns_mat <- as.data.frame(gene_matrix_ns)
copd_mat <- as.data.frame(gene_matrix_c)

# Set Gene as row names
rownames(ns_mat) <- ns_mat$Gene
ns_mat$Gene <- NULL

rownames(copd_mat) <- copd_mat$Gene
copd_mat$Gene <- NULL

# Keep genes present in BOTH datasets
common_genes <- intersect(rownames(ns_mat), rownames(copd_mat))

ns_mat <- ns_mat[common_genes, , drop = FALSE]
copd_mat <- copd_mat[common_genes, , drop = FALSE]

# Combine NS and COPD samples
combined_mat <- cbind(ns_mat, copd_mat)

# --------------------------------
# LOG2 TRANSFORMATION
# --------------------------------

combined_log2 <- log2(combined_mat + 1)

# --------------------------------
# Z-SCORE EACH GENE
# across ALL NS + COPD samples
# --------------------------------

combined_z <- t(scale(t(combined_log2)))

# Convert back to data frame
combined_z <- as.data.frame(combined_z)

# Put Gene back as a column
combined_z$Gene <- rownames(combined_z)

# Move Gene to first column
combined_z <- combined_z %>%
  select(Gene, everything())

write.csv(combined_z, "/Users/gagandeepkaur/Desktop/Z-score_copd_v_ns.csv")

```
